limits: Candidate schema and fixtures roll back; migration 28 is not installed in this database.
Lock probes use real separate PostgreSQL sessions with explicit synthetic rows; they do not run two committed correction/approval writers.
The packet and history join uses the production TypeScript protocol, not a connected application server or browser.
Fixtures use synthetic persistence preparation; production full-source review derivation retains its separate existing verification.
